scientific_integrity: Analytic moment and spectral identities, 2540 finite symbolic/numerical checks; non-Gaussian fourth-moment witness uses established beta-prime moment condition. No experimental or independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar two-state independent Markov switching; finite second moment; covariance equality is not Gaussian path-law equivalence. Heavy-tail exponent and general covariance methods are prior art; priority assessment is qualified.
title: Reentrant equilibrium-like covariance in a switching stable–inverted harmonic trap
